title: RBI Amendment Directions on Bulk Deposit Rate Disclosure and Pricing Requirements
description: <cite index="34-3,34-4">RBI's July 30, 2026 Amendment Directions tighten bulk-deposit rate disclosure timing (by 10:10 am daily) and mandate uniform pricing across branches for Commercial, Small Finance, RRB, Payments, Local Area and Urban Co-operative Banks, effective October 1, 2026.</cite>
